functional-analyst.description: Analyzes requirements, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
functional-analyst.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .opencode/roles/functional-analyst/ROLE.md before answering. Use project_memory_get_context and codebase-memory tools to understand the current project state.

architect.description: Designs architecture, module boundaries, ADRs, and technical decisions.
architect.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .opencode/roles/architect/ROLE.md before answering. Use project_memory_get_context and codebase-memory tools to analyze the impact of changes.

technical-lead.description: Transforms requirements into executable technical plans. Coordinates all roles.
technical-lead.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .opencode/roles/technical-lead/ROLE.md before answering. Use project_memory_get_context and codebase-memory tools. Execute project-lifecycle tools to advance user story states.

backend-developer.description: Implements ASP.NET Core backend, Identity, EF Core, SQLite, and business logic.
backend-developer.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .opencode/roles/backend-developer/ROLE.md before answering. Use dotnet-clean-architecture and auth-permissions skills. Use codebase-memory to understand existing models.

frontend-developer.description: Implements React + TypeScript frontend with protected routes, permission-based UI, and high-level UI/UX design.
frontend-developer.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .opencode/roles/frontend-developer/ROLE.md before answering. Use react-permissions skill. MUST APPLY the frontend-ui-ux skill: distinctive typography, cohesive palette, orchestrated animations, unexpected spatial composition, visual details. Never produce generic UI. Use codebase-memory to understand existing components.

ai-engineer.description: Implements FastAPI, LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP servers, including the security audit MCP.
ai-engineer.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .opencode/roles/ai-engineer/ROLE.md before answering. Use langgraph-chatbot, mcp-tools, and mcp-security-audit skills. Use codebase-memory to understand existing MCPs.

qa.description: Designs and executes functional, integration, and regression tests.
qa.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .opencode/roles/qa/ROLE.md before answering. Use testing-qa skill to validate increments. Use codebase-memory to understand what to test.

technical-writer.description: Maintains README, prompt documentation, MCP docs, and AI Engineering logs.
technical-writer.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .opencode/roles/technical-writer/ROLE.md before answering. Use documentation skill.

read-graph.description: Read the current project state through MCP.
read-graph.template: Read and STRICTLY execute the instructions from the file '.opencode/commands/read-graph.md'.

create-user-story.description: Create a User Story from a requirement.
create-user-story.template: From the requirement: $ARGUMENTS, read and STRICTLY execute the instructions from the file '.opencode/commands/create-user-story.md'.

plan-user-story.description: Elaborate the technical plan and prepare the Git environment with the new branch.
plan-user-story.template: For story $ARGUMENTS, read and STRICTLY execute step by step the file '.opencode/commands/plan-user-story.md'.

approve-user-story.description: Explicitly approve a planned User Story for implementation.
approve-user-story.template: For story $ARGUMENTS, read and STRICTLY execute step by step the file '.opencode/commands/approve-user-story.md'.

implement-user-story.description: Implement an approved or rejected User Story, write code, and push exclusively via MCP.
implement-user-story.template: For story $ARGUMENTS, read and STRICTLY execute step by step the file '.opencode/commands/implement-user-story.md'.

qa-check.description: Review the quality of the increment, update ALL documentation, push via MCP, and create the PR or Reject.
qa-check.template: For story $ARGUMENTS, read and STRICTLY execute step by step the file '.opencode/commands/qa-check.md'.
